narrative_shape: Phase orchestrator whose visible work is record, dispatch, and standby. Turn 69 writes a unit outcome, turn 72 dispatches unit 2-15, and turn 74 waits on that agent before a phase-close commit. Turns 83–90 are a pytest/lint rerun watched with Monitor ("I'll poll with Monitor rather than waiting blind", then "still running"). Agent stays at 2. Monitor goes 3→5. This is parent standby, not a builder loop.

phases.note: Ledger check, then Monitor on pytest/lint. IMPLEMENTATION.md reread reaches 3. Still waiting at turn 90.

rationale: The shape inside ≤120 is dispatch-and-wait. That is poll/monitor as a parent session, distinct from code thrash. The run is still in that wait at the last checkpoint, so there is no later outcome to reclassify it.
